Glossary

Every word at three levels: everyday words, biology words and full names. Words not introduced yet are dimmed.

Before · never used

At the molecular level

Zoom from the whole body (meters) to organs (centimeters), cells (micrometers) and molecules (nanometers). The time ruler zooms from years down to nanoseconds; each level has its own natural timescale. Simulations show mechanisms and relative changes, not clinical values.
